js-quantities v1.8.0
https://github.com/gentooboontoo/js-quantities

Vendored locally (not loaded from a CDN) so the app has no runtime
dependency on a third-party host. Unmodified upstream ESM build
(`build/quantities.mjs` from the npm package), used only for its unit
kind/conversion tables — the app's own conversion logic lives in
`src/units.js`.
